709	    tokens = tokenize(text)
710	
711	    def line_of(tok):
712	        return text.count("\n", 0, tok.pos) + 1
713	
714	    def with_line(tok, fn, *args):
715	        try:
716	            return fn(*args)
717	        except MTLError as e:
718	            if e.kind == "bad_dsl" and not e.message.startswith("line "):
719	                raise dsl_error(f"line {line_of(tok)}: {e.message}")
720	            raise
721	
722	    r = Parser(tokens=tokens)
723	    schemas = {}
724	    program = None
725	    while True:
726	        r.skip_nl()
727	        tok = r.peek()
728	        if tok.kind == "eof":

915	def resolve_schemas(decls, deferred):
916	    for name, decl in decls.items():
917	        seen = [name]
918	        cur = decl.base
919	        while cur is not None:
920	            if cur not in decls:
921	                raise dsl_error(f"schema '{seen[-1]}' extends unknown schema '{cur}'")
922	            if cur in seen:
923	                raise dsl_error(f"circular schema inheritance: {' -> '.join(seen + [cur])}")
924	            seen.append(cur)
925	            cur = decls[cur].base
926	
927	    resolved = {}
928	
929	    def build(name):
930	        if name in resolved:
931	            return resolved[name]
932	        decl = decls[name]
933	        fields = {}
934	        if decl.base is not None:
935	            fields = {k: SchemaField(v.typ, v.expr) for k, v in build(decl.base)[0].items()}
936	        declared = set()
937	        for fd in decl.fields:
938	            where = f"line {fd.line}: "
939	            if fd.name in declared:
940	                raise dsl_error(f"{where}field '{fd.name}' is declared more than once in schema '{name}'")
941	            declared.add(fd.name)
942	            expr = fd.expr
943	            if expr is not None:
944	                for ref in col_refs(expr):
945	                    if ref == fd.name:
946	                        raise dsl_error(f"{where}calculated field '{fd.name}' cannot reference itself")
947	                    if ref not in fields:
948	                        later = any(f.name == ref for f in decl.fields)
949	                        kind = "forward reference to" if later else "unknown field"
950	                        raise dsl_error(f"{where}calculated field '{fd.name}' has {kind} '{ref}'")
951	                for n in walk(expr):
952	                    if isinstance(n, Call) and n.name in ("lag", "lead"):
953	                        raise dsl_error(f"{where}{n.name}() is only allowed in @stage(post_agg) calcs")
954	            old = fields.get(fd.name)
955	            if old is not None:
956	                if not (old.typ == fd.typ or (old.typ == INT and fd.typ == FLOAT)):
957	                    deferred.append(type_error(
958	                        f"schema '{name}' illegally overrides field '{fd.name}' from {old.typ} to {fd.typ}"))
959	                if expr is None:
960	                    expr = old.expr
961	            fields[fd.name] = SchemaField(fd.typ, expr)
962	        order = []
963	        state = {}
964	
965	        def visit(fname, path):
966	            if state.get(fname) == "done":
967	                return
968	            if state.get(fname) == "active":
969	                raise dsl_error(f"circular calculated fields in schema '{name}': {' -> '.join(path + [fname])}")
970	            state[fname] = "active"
971	            for ref in col_refs(fields[fname].expr):
972	                if ref in fields and fields[ref].expr is not None:
973	                    visit(ref, path + [fname])
974	            state[fname] = "done"
975	            order.append(fname)
976	
977	        for fname, f in fields.items():
978	            if f.expr is not None:
979	                visit(fname, [])
980	        resolved[name] = (fields, order)
981	        return resolved[name]
982	
983	    for name in decls:
984	        build(name)
985	    return resolved

1007	def finalize_block_program(program, schemas, cli_params):
1008	    if program.schema_name not in schemas:
1009	        raise dsl_error(f"pipeline uses unknown schema '{program.schema_name}'")
1010	    resolved = resolve_schemas(schemas, program.deferred_errors)
1011	    fields, order = resolved[program.schema_name]
1012	    program.schema_fields = fields
1013	    program.schema_calc_order = order
1014	    params = program.params
1015	
1016	    for decl in params.values():
1017	        if decl.default is None and decl.name not in cli_params:
1018	            raise dsl_error(f"parameter '{decl.name}' has no default and was not provided via --param")
1019	
1020	    for f in fields.values():
1021	        if f.expr is not None:
1022	            check_expr_structure(f.expr, params, post=False)
1023	    for step in program.steps:
1024	        expr = step[1].expr if step[0] == "calc" else step[1]
1025	        check_expr_structure(expr, params, post=False)
1026	    for calc in program.post_calcs:
1027	        check_expr_structure(calc.expr, params, post=True)
1028	    if program.window_param is not None and program.window_param not in params:
1029	        raise dsl_error(f"unknown parameter '{program.window_param}'")
1030	
1031	    pre_calcs = [s[1] for s in program.steps if s[0] == "calc"]
1032	    apply_names = {s[2] for s in program.steps if s[0] == "apply"}
1033	    aliases = {a[2] for a in program.aggregates}
1034	    seen = set()
1035	    for calc in pre_calcs + program.post_calcs:
1036	        if calc.name in seen:
1037	            raise dsl_error(f"calc '{calc.name}' is declared more than once")
1038	        seen.add(calc.name)
1039	        if calc.stage == "pre" and (calc.name in fields or calc.name in apply_names):
1040	            raise dsl_error(f"calc '{calc.name}' collides with an existing field")
1041	    validate_output_keys(program)
1042	
1043	    # Pre-stage calcs run before every other step, unless they depend on an apply(...) column,
1044	    # in which case they run at their position in the pipeline body.
1045	    available = set(fields)
1046	    hoisted = set()
1047	    for calc in pre_calcs:
1048	        if all(ref in available for ref in col_refs(calc.expr)):
1049	            hoisted.add(calc.name)
1050	            available.add(calc.name)
1051	    execution = [s for s in program.steps if s[0] == "calc" and s[1].name in hoisted]
1052	    later_calcs = {c.name for c in pre_calcs} | {c.name for c in program.post_calcs}
1053	    for step in program.steps:
1054	        if step[0] == "calc":
1055	            calc = step[1]
1056	            if calc.name in hoisted:
1057	                continue
1058	            for ref in col_refs(calc.expr):
1059	                if ref in available:
1060	                    continue
1061	                if ref in aliases:
1062	                    raise dsl_error(f"pre-stage calc '{calc.name}' cannot reference aggregate alias '{ref}'")
1063	                if ref in later_calcs:
1064	                    raise dsl_error(f"calc '{calc.name}' references '{ref}' before it is defined")
1065	                raise dsl_error(f"calc '{calc.name}' references unknown field '{ref}'")
1066	            available.add(calc.name)
1067	        elif step[0] == "apply":
1068	            available.add(step[2])
1069	        execution.append(step)
1070	    program.order = execution
1071	
1072	    post_names = [c.name for c in program.post_calcs]
1073	    for idx, calc in enumerate(program.post_calcs):
1074	        for ref in col_refs(calc.expr):
1075	            if ref in post_names[idx:]:
1076	                raise dsl_error(f"calc '{calc.name}' references '{ref}' before it is defined")
